FN-2YF9IS-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 251
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Jerry Starnes
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/30/2023
House Bill 251 as passed the House of Representatives expands the Alabama Veteran Tag
Program to include veterans of Operation Inherent Resolve. The required issuance fee to obtain
such license plate is the same as for all other the plate license plates ($23.00 annually), and there
is an additional issuance fee of $3.00 in years when the actual metal plate is issued (initially and
every five years thereafter). The standard fee would be distributed as follows:
State General Fund $10.00
Public Road and Bridge Fund $ 9.30
Municipalities $ 2.52
Counties $ 1.18
Total $23.00
In addition, this bill provides that persons eligible to receive this distinctive tag are also eligible
to personalize such tags upon the payment of an additional annual issuance fee of $50.00, for
each personalized tag issued, which would be distributed as follows:
2.5% Commission to License Plate Issuing Official $ 1.25
Department of Corrections (Manufacturing Costs) $ 3.00
Alabama Veterans' Assistance Fund $45.75
Total $50.00
Additionally, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Veterans Affairs to provide certificates of eligibility to such license plate applicants.
